column1: # Campaign-side eval set (#422) — landing pages with the content categories we'd accept.
# url <TAB> ad-product category id <TAB> accepted content categories <TAB> note
#   ad-product id: AdProductTaxonomy (what the advertiser declares at creation).
#   accepted: `|`-separated IAB Content Taxonomy 3.0 ids; ANY one present = hit;
#   a child of an accepted id also counts as hit, an ancestor as "broad", a
#   sibling as WRONG. Unrelated extras are not judged — watch the count column.
#   ad-product id may be empty: production sends none today (creative.declared_category is blank on every row, 2026-11-01).
#   Landing pages from production `creative` rows, 2026-11-01. Labels are a first draft — correct them freely.
